text: ἡ Κοάλα ἐκφέρει ἐκ τοῦ σάκκου τὸ μῆλον καὶ τὸν ἄρτον. ἡ Κοάλα δίδωσι τὸν ἄρτον τῇ Γλαυκί.
objects: a small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child
a shiny red apple with a small green leaf
a small round loaf of bread with a golden crust
positioning: Koala sits at the table holding the apple in one paw and extending the bread toward Glaux with the other paw.
Glaux perches on the table edge, leaning forward to accept the bread from Koala.
The small acorn-brown backpack with leaf-green straps and a flap, sized for a child lies open on the tabletop.
The shiny red apple with a small green leaf is in Koala's left paw.
The small round loaf of bread with a golden crust is being passed from Koala to Glaux.
